list.name: Scraper failures
list.rawSql:
SELECT started_at AS time,
       COALESCE(finished_at, started_at + INTERVAL '15 minutes') AS time_end,
       COALESCE(NULLIF(left(error, 160), ''), 'run failed') AS text
FROM reporting.scrape_health
WHERE status = 'error'
  AND $__timeFilter(started_at)

description: Everything about ads that disappeared — the closest thing olx.ba offers to sold prices. Exit prices are last ASKING prices observed before removal, not transaction prices.

panels.title: Closed listings · 30 d
panels.description: Ads gone from every configured search in the last month.

targets.rawSql:
WITH closed AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT l.article_id, l.closing_ppm2, e.days_listed
  FROM reporting.exits_closed_filtered(
    now() - INTERVAL '30 days', NULL::timestamptz, false,
    ARRAY[${category:sqlstring}]::text[], reporting.dashboard_numeric(${min_sqm:sqlstring}),
    reporting.dashboard_numeric(${max_sqm:sqlstring}), ARRAY[${rooms:sqlstring}]::text[],
    ARRAY[${deal:sqlstring}]::text[], ARRAY[${neighborhood:sqlstring}]::text[]) l
  LEFT JOIN reporting.exit_economics e USING (article_id)
),
active AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT l.article_id
  FROM reporting.listings_filtered(
    ARRAY[${category:sqlstring}]::text[], reporting.dashboard_numeric(${min_sqm:sqlstring}),
    reporting.dashboard_numeric(${max_sqm:sqlstring}), ARRAY[${neighborhood:sqlstring}]::text[]) l
  WHERE reporting.room_bucket(l.rooms) = ANY (ARRAY[${rooms:sqlstring}]::text[])
    AND CASE WHEN l.is_rent THEN 'rent' ELSE 'sell' END = ANY (ARRAY[${deal:sqlstring}]::text[])
)
SELECT count(*) AS closed_30d,
       percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY closing_ppm2)
         FILTER (WHERE closing_ppm2 > 0) AS median_exit_ppm2,
       round(count(*)::float /
         NULLIF(count(*)::float + (SELECT count(*)::float FROM active), 0) * 100)::int
         AS observed_exit_ratio,
       percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY days_listed) AS median_days_on_market
FROM closed

panels.title: Exit KM/m² vs asking KM/m² — daily medians
panels.description: Green line: exit askings of ads that closed. Blue: pooled reconstructed daily inventory asking median for the selected filters. Estimated, stale and provisional fields expose historical availability quality.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 'daily'::text AS period,
       date_trunc('day', l.closed_at AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo') AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo' AS time,
       percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY l.closing_ppm2) AS "exit KM/m2 (closed ads)"
FROM reporting.exits_closed_filtered($__timeFrom(), $__timeTo(), true, ARRAY[${category:sqlstring}]::text[], reporting.dashboard_numeric(${min_sqm:sqlstring}), reporting.dashboard_numeric(${max_sqm:sqlstring}), ARRAY[${rooms:sqlstring}]::text[], ARRAY[${deal:sqlstring}]::text[], ARRAY[${neighborhood:sqlstring}]::text[]) l
WHERE l.closing_ppm2 > 0
GROUP BY 2 ORDER BY 2

WITH filtered AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT d.day, d.price_state, d.ppm2, d.membership_inferred,
         d.attributes_inferred, d.stale_observation, d.provisional_day
  FROM reporting.daily_listing_facts_olap d
  WHERE d.day BETWEEN date($__timeFrom() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')
                  AND LEAST(date($__timeTo() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo'),
                            (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date)
    AND (COALESCE(cardinality(ARRAY[${category:sqlstring}]::text[]), 0) = 0
      OR d.category_memberships && ARRAY[${category:sqlstring}]::text[]
      OR d.category = ANY (ARRAY[${category:sqlstring}]::text[]))
    AND (reporting.dashboard_numeric(${min_sqm:sqlstring}) IS NULL OR d.sqm IS NULL
      OR d.sqm >= reporting.dashboard_numeric(${min_sqm:sqlstring}))
    AND (reporting.dashboard_numeric(${max_sqm:sqlstring}) IS NULL OR d.sqm IS NULL
      OR d.sqm <= reporting.dashboard_numeric(${max_sqm:sqlstring}))
    AND (COALESCE(cardinality(ARRAY[${rooms:sqlstring}]::text[]), 0) = 0
      OR d.rooms = ANY (ARRAY[${rooms:sqlstring}]::text[])
      OR d.room_bucket = ANY (ARRAY[${rooms:sqlstring}]::text[]))
    AND (CASE WHEN d.deal = 'rent' THEN 'rent' ELSE 'sale' END) = ANY (
      ARRAY(SELECT CASE WHEN selected = 'sell' THEN 'sale' ELSE selected END
              FROM unnest(ARRAY[${deal:sqlstring}]::text[]) AS t(selected)))
    AND (COALESCE(cardinality(ARRAY[${neighborhood:sqlstring}]::text[]), 0) = 0
      OR d.neighborhood = ANY (ARRAY[${neighborhood:sqlstring}]::text[])
      OR d.location = ANY (ARRAY[${neighborhood:sqlstring}]::text[]))
), daily AS (
  SELECT day, count(*)::numeric AS inventory,
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE price_state = 'valid')::numeric AS valid_prices,
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE price_state = 'valid' AND ppm2 IS NOT NULL)::bigint AS priced_count,
         percentile_cont(0.25) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ppm2)
           FILTER (WHERE price_state = 'valid' AND ppm2 IS NOT NULL) AS p25,
         percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ppm2)
           FILTER (WHERE price_state = 'valid' AND ppm2 IS NOT NULL) AS median,
         percentile_cont(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ppm2)
           FILTER (WHERE price_state = 'valid' AND ppm2 IS NOT NULL) AS p75,
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE membership_inferred OR attributes_inferred)::bigint AS estimated_count,
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE stale_observation)::bigint AS stale_count,
         bool_or(provisional_day) AS provisional_day
  FROM filtered GROUP BY day
), weekly AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('week', day::timestamp)::date AS day,
         avg(inventory) AS inventory, avg(valid_prices) AS valid_prices,
         round(100.0 * avg(valid_prices) / NULLIF(avg(inventory), 0), 2) AS priced_share
  FROM daily GROUP BY 1
), combined AS (
  SELECT 'daily'::text AS period, day, p25, median, p75, inventory,
         priced_count, valid_prices, estimated_count, stale_count,
         provisional_day, NULL::numeric AS priced_share
  FROM daily
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'weekly'::text, day, NULL::numeric, NULL::numeric, NULL::numeric,
         inventory, NULL::bigint, valid_prices, NULL::bigint, NULL::bigint,
         NULL::boolean, priced_share
  FROM weekly
)
SELECT period, day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo' AS time,
       p25 AS "p25 KM/m2", median AS "median KM/m2", p75 AS "p75 KM/m2",
       inventory, priced_count AS "priced sample", valid_prices AS "valid price count",
       estimated_count AS estimated, stale_count AS stale,
       provisional_day AS provisional, priced_share AS "priced share %"
FROM combined ORDER BY day, period

panels.title: Days on market — closed listings
panels.description: How long ads survived before disappearing, in the selected period.

targets.rawSql:
WITH base AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT l.article_id, l.rooms, l.closing_price, l.closed_at,
         e.article_id AS economics_article_id, e.opening_price, e.days_listed,
         CASE WHEN e.opening_price > 0
              THEN round((l.closing_price - e.opening_price) / e.opening_price * 100)::int END AS change_pct
  FROM reporting.exits_closed_filtered(
    $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo(), true, ARRAY[${category:sqlstring}]::text[],
    reporting.dashboard_numeric(${min_sqm:sqlstring}), reporting.dashboard_numeric(${max_sqm:sqlstring}),
    ARRAY[${rooms:sqlstring}]::text[], ARRAY[${deal:sqlstring}]::text[], ARRAY[${neighborhood:sqlstring}]::text[]) l
  LEFT JOIN reporting.exit_economics e USING (article_id)
),
duration AS (
  SELECT 'duration'::text AS dimension,
         CASE WHEN days_listed <= 7 THEN '0-7 d'
              WHEN days_listed <= 14 THEN '8-14 d'
              WHEN days_listed <= 30 THEN '15-30 d'
              WHEN days_listed <= 60 THEN '31-60 d'
              ELSE '60+ d' END AS bucket,
         count(*) AS exits, min(days_listed)::numeric AS sort_key
  FROM base WHERE economics_article_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
room_counts AS (
  SELECT 'rooms'::text AS dimension, reporting.room_bucket(rooms) AS bucket,
         count(*) AS exits,
         CASE reporting.room_bucket(rooms)
           WHEN '0' THEN 0 WHEN '1' THEN 1 WHEN '2' THEN 2
           WHEN '3' THEN 3 WHEN '4+' THEN 4 WHEN 'unknown' THEN 5 ELSE 6 END::numeric AS sort_key
  FROM base GROUP BY 1, 2
),
discount AS (
  SELECT 'discount'::text AS dimension,
         CASE WHEN change_pct IS NULL THEN '(unknown)'
              WHEN change_pct <= -20 THEN '-20 % or worse'
              WHEN change_pct <= -10 THEN '-10..-20 %'
              WHEN change_pct < 0 THEN '0..-10 %'
              WHEN change_pct = 0 THEN 'flat'
              ELSE 'raised' END AS bucket,
         count(*) AS exits, -count(*)::numeric AS sort_key
  FROM base WHERE economics_article_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT dimension, bucket, exits, sort_key FROM duration
UNION ALL SELECT dimension, bucket, exits, sort_key FROM room_counts
UNION ALL SELECT dimension, bucket, exits, sort_key FROM discount
ORDER BY dimension, sort_key, bucket

panels.title: Recently closed — exit price vs original ask
panels.description: change_pct compares the final asking price with the first one we observed. Negative (red) = exited below its original ask.

targets.rawSql:
WITH recent AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT l.*
FROM reporting.exits_closed_filtered($__timeFrom(), $__timeTo(), true, ARRAY[${category:sqlstring}]::text[], reporting.dashboard_numeric(${min_sqm:sqlstring}), reporting.dashboard_numeric(${max_sqm:sqlstring}), ARRAY[${rooms:sqlstring}]::text[], ARRAY[${deal:sqlstring}]::text[], ARRAY[${neighborhood:sqlstring}]::text[]) l
ORDER BY l.closed_at DESC
LIMIT 100
)
SELECT l.title, l.url, l.location, l.sqm, l.rooms,
       l.closing_price, l.closing_ppm2, lc.opening_price,
       round(l.closing_price - lc.opening_price) AS price_change,
       CASE WHEN lc.opening_price > 0
            THEN round((l.closing_price - lc.opening_price) / lc.opening_price * 100)::int END AS change_pct,
       lc.days_listed, l.closed_at
FROM recent l
JOIN reporting.exit_economics lc ON lc.article_id = l.article_id
ORDER BY l.closed_at DESC

targets.rawSql:
SELECT l.latitude, l.longitude, l.title, l.url,
       l.closing_price, l.closing_ppm2, l.closed_at,
       l.location AS location
FROM reporting.exits_closed_filtered($__timeFrom(), $__timeTo(), true, ARRAY[${category:sqlstring}]::text[], reporting.dashboard_numeric(${min_sqm:sqlstring}), reporting.dashboard_numeric(${max_sqm:sqlstring}), ARRAY[${rooms:sqlstring}]::text[], ARRAY[${deal:sqlstring}]::text[], ARRAY[${neighborhood:sqlstring}]::text[]) l

panels.description: Table form of the exit map: closed ads that had pins. Click a title to open the ad on olx.ba.

panels.title: Exit discount vs original ask
panels.description: How final asks compared to the first price we saw. Flat market → most ads exit at their opening ask.

panels.title: Priced share — weekly
panels.description: Weekly priced-share proxy from reconstructed listing-day inventory using the selected dashboard filters. It is not a transaction rate; inferred, stale and provisional rows are part of the historical availability model.

panels.title: Days on market vs exit discount
panels.description: Each closed sale ad as a point: how long it sat (x) vs how its final asking price compared to the first one we saw (y). Points drifting downward to the right = stale ads exiting at bigger discounts. Days-on-market is a lower bound until published_at converges; exit prices are askings, not transactions.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT lc.days_listed AS days_on_market,
       round(100.0 * (l.closing_price - lc.opening_price) / NULLIF(lc.opening_price, 0), 1)::double precision AS exit_vs_opening_pct
FROM reporting.exits_closed_filtered($__timeFrom(), $__timeTo(), true, ARRAY[${category:sqlstring}]::text[], reporting.dashboard_numeric(${min_sqm:sqlstring}), reporting.dashboard_numeric(${max_sqm:sqlstring}), ARRAY[${rooms:sqlstring}]::text[], ARRAY[${deal:sqlstring}]::text[], ARRAY[${neighborhood:sqlstring}]::text[]) l
JOIN reporting.exit_economics lc ON lc.article_id = l.article_id
WHERE lc.opening_price > 0 AND l.closing_price IS NOT NULL AND lc.days_listed IS NOT NULL

panels.title: Exit rate by KM/m² bracket · 30 d
panels.description: Share of ads that exited per price bracket, brackets cut at the live quartiles of the combined active+closed pool. Cheap segments may be high-churn; expensive ones may just sit.

targets.rawSql:
WITH c AS (
  SELECT l.closing_ppm2 AS ppm2
  FROM reporting.exits_closed_filtered(
    now() - INTERVAL '30 days', NULL::timestamptz, false,
    ARRAY[${category:sqlstring}]::text[], reporting.dashboard_numeric(${min_sqm:sqlstring}),
    reporting.dashboard_numeric(${max_sqm:sqlstring}), ARRAY[${rooms:sqlstring}]::text[],
    ARRAY[${deal:sqlstring}]::text[], ARRAY[${neighborhood:sqlstring}]::text[]) l
  WHERE l.closing_ppm2 > 0
),
a AS (
  SELECT l.ppm2 AS ppm2
  FROM reporting.listings_filtered(
    ARRAY[${category:sqlstring}]::text[], reporting.dashboard_numeric(${min_sqm:sqlstring}),
    reporting.dashboard_numeric(${max_sqm:sqlstring}), ARRAY[${neighborhood:sqlstring}]::text[]) l
  WHERE l.ppm2 > 0
    AND reporting.room_bucket(l.rooms) = ANY (ARRAY[${rooms:sqlstring}]::text[])
    AND CASE WHEN l.is_rent THEN 'rent' ELSE 'sell' END = ANY (ARRAY[${deal:sqlstring}]::text[])
),
bounds AS (
  SELECT percentile_cont(0.25) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ppm2) AS q25,
         percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ppm2) AS q50,
         percentile_cont(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ppm2) AS q75
  FROM (SELECT ppm2 FROM c UNION ALL SELECT ppm2 FROM a) p
),
tagged AS (
  SELECT 'exit' AS kind, ppm2 FROM c
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'active', ppm2 FROM a
)
SELECT CASE WHEN t.ppm2 < b.q25 THEN 'Q1 · cheapest'
            WHEN t.ppm2 < b.q50 THEN 'Q2'
            WHEN t.ppm2 < b.q75 THEN 'Q3'
            ELSE 'Q4 · priciest' END AS bucket,
       round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE t.kind = 'exit') / NULLIF(count(*), 0), 1)::double precision AS exits_pct
FROM tagged t CROSS JOIN bounds b
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Exit rate by neighborhood — 30 d
panels.description: Observed closed ads / (closed + active) by district over the last 30 days. A disappearance proxy, not a transaction rate. Requires at least 10 combined listings; ignores Neighborhood while the other filters apply.

targets.rawSql:
WITH ex AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN l.latitude IS NULL THEN '(no pin)'
              ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(l.location, ''), '(unmapped)') END AS district,
         count(*)::int AS closed_n
  FROM reporting.exits_closed_filtered(
    now() - INTERVAL '30 days', NULL::timestamptz, false,
    ARRAY[${category:sqlstring}]::text[], reporting.dashboard_numeric(${min_sqm:sqlstring}),
    reporting.dashboard_numeric(${max_sqm:sqlstring}), ARRAY[${rooms:sqlstring}]::text[],
    ARRAY[${deal:sqlstring}]::text[], ARRAY[]::text[]) l
  GROUP BY 1
),
ac AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN l.latitude IS NULL THEN '(no pin)'
              ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(l.location, ''), '(unmapped)') END AS district,
         count(*)::int AS active_n
  FROM reporting.listings_filtered(
    ARRAY[${category:sqlstring}]::text[], reporting.dashboard_numeric(${min_sqm:sqlstring}),
    reporting.dashboard_numeric(${max_sqm:sqlstring}), ARRAY[]::text[]) l
  WHERE reporting.room_bucket(l.rooms) = ANY (ARRAY[${rooms:sqlstring}]::text[])
    AND CASE WHEN l.is_rent THEN 'rent' ELSE 'sell' END = ANY (ARRAY[${deal:sqlstring}]::text[])
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT ex.district, ex.closed_n AS closed_30d, COALESCE(ac.active_n, 0) AS actives,
       round(100.0 * ex.closed_n / NULLIF(ex.closed_n + COALESCE(ac.active_n, 0), 0), 1)::double precision AS exit_rate_pct
FROM ex
LEFT JOIN ac USING (district)
WHERE ex.closed_n + COALESCE(ac.active_n, 0) >= 10
ORDER BY exit_rate_pct DESC
